title: ELMFIRE validation inputs and observations for 31 wildfires
description:
This collection contains input rasters, required input tables, fire observations and data-generation source for 31 wildfires used in ELMFIRE validation studies. 31 datasets support implemented validation cases. Each fire has a separate archive containing input and observation bundles and data-generation scripts where supplied, file inventories, checksums, a README, and a Python restoration script. Historical model outputs, runners and model configurations are excluded. Camp, Thomas, and Tubbs contain VIIRS active-fire observations; the other 28 fires contain GOFER-derived arrival-time TIFFs and PNG previews, plus CAL FIRE final-perimeter GeoPackages and aligned 30 m mask TIFFs. The GeoPackages retain CAL FIRE records and the final GOFER perimeter. Input preparation and CAL FIRE perimeter-generation sources are included. All 28 GOFER fires also include supplementary ws_gust.tif rasters and updated case-local gust-generation scripts. NOAA RTMA 10-m gusts were converted to mph at 20 ft and bilinearly interpolated onto each weather grid. Regular wind rasters are retained; gust selection is controlled by the model configuration.

Chris Lautenberger and Daniel San Martin are credited for the 28 GOFER-related fire datasets. Dwi M. J. Purnomo, Maria Theodori, and Kasra Shamsaei are credited for Camp, Thomas, and Tubbs.

GOFER source attribution: Liu, Tianjia; Randerson, James T.; Chen, Yang; Morton, Douglas C.; Wiggins, Elizabeth B.; Smyth, Padhraic; Foufoula-Georgiou, Efi; Nadler, Roy; Nevo, Omer. GOES-Observed Fire Event Representation (GOFER) product for 28 California wildfires from 2019-2021. Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8327264 (all versions). The supplied observations are derived arrival-time rasters; the exact source version and complete transformation history remain unverified. GOFER source license: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. License evidence was checked against version 0.2 (2025), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14642378; this does not establish which version was used for the supplied rasters.

Known limitations: the exact GOFER source version and complete transformation history remain unverified. Upstream products and the exact VIIRS collections for Camp, Thomas, and Tubbs are incompletely identified. Redistribution terms for separately supplied model inputs and other third-party material remain under review. These limitations are documented in the per-fire metadata and source metadata. File integrity does not establish model accuracy.

Acknowledgement: OpenAI Codex assisted with archive preparation, metadata organization, and drafting the accompanying documentation.
